fe-design-archetype.detail: Re-judged at source commit 1ec2bf03249c by opening evidence/screenshots/az-planting-calendar-1280-light.png and reading it. Needed because the shell de-duplication changed /design-system, which is source for this app, so the prior judgement no longer described the shipped commit. Same verdict against Option 3 'Timeline + rail' (DECISION.md line 13): the half-month timeline is the hero with a count chip per period and Aug 1 marked NOW; crop rows are secondary beneath it under 'Plantable in Aug 1', 7 crops with image, method badge, days-to-harvest and a cited source link; the planting assistant is a docked desktop right rail. The render is genuinely fresh -- it reads 'As of 2026-08-04'. DEVIATION carried forward: the zone IS a full-width bar but sits BELOW the crop search, which DECISION.md line 9 sanctions as a 'sticky chrome' search placement. Judged from the rendered screenshot, not from component source.
